summary: This PR closes four real, narrow gaps left after PR #596 already built the core BOQ revision-chain/diff machinery: it upgrades the existing soft 'scope already executed' warning into a real 409 hard-block enforced inside createBoqRevision()'s own DB transaction (verified withTenantContext wraps the work in a genuine db.transaction, so a block rolls back the inserted revision and line items, not just the offending rows), adds an explicit allowScopeReductionOverride escape hatch, generalizes compareBoq() to diff any two revisions in a project (with a same-project guard) instead of only adjacent ones, adds a derived (not stored) totalVariation figure consistent with the file's existing live-aggregation convention, and fills in missing v1/PROJEXA-facing routes as thin re-exports that exactly match the auth/role pattern of sibling v1 routes (requireAuthOrApiKey on GET, plus requireRoleOrScope('member','write') on the POST). The core violation logic is a small pure, unit-tested helper shared identically between the warning path and the hard-block path so they cannot drift apart, and the new tests cover the meaningful edge cases (0% and no-progress-entry items, items with no activityId, positive vs negative variation). Diff stays within API routes, one service file, its tests, and PROGRESS.md -- no schema/migration/auth/permission/billing/rls files and no .github/workflows changes, consistent with the tier1 classification.
